rationale: Both analyses respect the low-confidence boundary, retain the 58-hour cache and unknown-source limitations, exclude the filtered Garmin records, avoid a direct load increase from the single comparable rowing result, and specify follow-up collection. A is more rigorous because it explicitly separates facts, inferences, and uncertainties throughout; limits recommendations to two bounded changes with rollback conditions; and gives a fuller verification plan. B is concise and safe, but its evidence separation and operational verification detail are less systematic.
